about: Fact-check eval sources: short original documents written for this suite. Each paragraph is one passage. Nothing here is a real place, product or organisation.

sources.title: The Kestrel Bridge: a short history
passages: The Kestrel Bridge opened on 14 June 1932 after four years of construction. It spans the river Wend for 412 metres.
The bridge was designed by the engineer Mara Ellison, who also designed the Wend lock gates. Her design used riveted steel arches.
The bridge closed to motor traffic in 1998. Since then only pedestrians and cyclists may cross it.
The bridge is repainted every seven years. Since 2004 the paint has been a lead-free grey.

sources.title: SI-200 solar inverter manual
passages: The SI-200 accepts a maximum input voltage of 600 V from the panels. It operates between minus 20 and 55 degrees Celsius.
Fault code F-07 means the grid voltage is out of range. The inverter reconnects by itself when the grid recovers.
Do not install the SI-200 in direct sunlight. Mount it on a shaded wall with 30 centimetres of clearance on every side.
The SI-200 carries a warranty of 10 years from the date of installation.

sources.title: Keeping a sourdough starter
passages: Feed the starter with equal weights of starter, flour and water. At 24 degrees the starter peaks about 6 hours after a feed.
Rye flour ferments faster than white flour, so a rye starter needs feeding more often.
A starter kept in the fridge needs feeding once a week. Bring it back to room temperature before baking.
A grey liquid on top of the starter is harmless. Pour it off or stir it back in.

sources.title: Brightwater Library annual report 2025
passages: Brightwater Library welcomed 48,200 visitors in 2025, 12 percent more than in 2024.
Opening hours on Thursdays were extended to 8 pm in March 2025.
Digital lending grew to 31 percent of all loans in 2025.
The library did not raise its membership fees in 2025. Membership remains free for under-18s.

sources.title: Remote work policy
passages: Staff may work remotely for up to three days each week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00.
Every member of staff receives an equipment allowance of 400 pounds every two years.
Requests to work fully remotely must be approved by a director, not a line manager.
Remote workers must not use public wifi for client work without the company VPN.

sources.title: Northline rail timetable
passages: The first Northline train leaves Harrow Cross at 05:40 and the last leaves at 23:15.
The journey from Harrow Cross to Fellmouth takes 47 minutes with six stops.
Bicycles are not allowed on Northline trains between 07:00 and 09:30 on weekdays.
Season tickets are sold at every staffed station and online.
